instruction: Query the OQMD database for stable Fe binary compounds (element_set=Fe AND ntypes=2), sorted by delta_e, save total count and top 5 to 'C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\setup\output_result\oqmd\oqmd_task_13.txt'. Use the OQMD REST API directly with the `requests` library (endpoint: https://oqmd.org/oqmdapi/formationenergy), do NOT use qmpy_rester.
